definition: the person who tells the story
description: Inside a wooden barn at night, lit by old oil lanterns. A young man in a checked shirt, grey vest, braces and rolled trousers stands barefoot in front of the open barn door with his arms spread wide, telling a story. He leans forward with a wild face and then jumps up with both hands high in the air. A group of young friends sit on hay bales around him with mugs and plates, staring at him with open mouths, and a shaggy grey dog sits at his feet.
